tools.name: linkedin_create_post
tools.description: Publish exactly the supplied text as the connected LinkedIn member with PUBLIC or CONNECTIONS visibility. If the outcome is unknown, check LinkedIn before repeating; another call can publish twice.

expectedAccountId.description: The accountId (from the account tool) this write is meant for. A different connected account refuses the call.

tools.name: linkedin_get_account
tools.description: Return the connected LinkedIn account's display name, accountId, organization, granted scopes, token expiry and available tools. Use accountId as expectedAccountId when posting.
